body:
Another data point. This startup output is also missing in 1.7.0.Final, where it exists in 1.6.1.Final:
```
INFO  [io.qua.grp.run.GrpcServerRecorder] () gRPC Server started on 0.0.0.0:9000 [SSL enabled: false]
```

Note that I can still make gRPC calls, but the startup output never indicated that the gRPC Server was started (even though it's obviously running as calls succeed).

and the log says: 
```
2020-08-25 22:13:38,441 INFO  [io.qua.grp.run.GrpcServerRecorder] (vert.x-eventloop-thread-1) gRPC Server started on 0.0.0.0:9000 [SSL enabled: false]
2020-08-25 22:13:38,507 INFO  [io.quarkus] (main) code-with-quarkus 1.0.0-SNAPSHOT on JVM (powered by Quarkus 1.7.0.Final) started in 0.718s. Listening on: http://0.0.0.0:8080
2020-08-25 22:13:38,508 INFO  [io.quarkus] (main) Profile prod activated. 
2020-08-25 22:13:38,508 INFO  [io.quarkus] (main) Installed features: [cdi, grpc-server, mutiny, resteasy, smallrye-context-propagation, smallrye-health, vertx]
```

I see the behavior you described when running `quarkus:dev`, I'll change the subject to reflect that.
Please let me know if you see it with normal execution too

rename.from: Quarkus 1.7.0.Final + grpc + smallrye health gRPC Server is DOWN
rename.to: devmode: Quarkus 1.7.0.Final + grpc + smallrye health gRPC Server is DOWN

body:
Sorry, yes. You are correct. 
This only exhibits in dev-mode. Running the jar has the expected behavior, where the smallrye healthcheck passes, and the startup output also includes the gRPC Server startup line.

issue.title: Fix gRPC health reporting for devmode
